business_problem: The team at zeb is passionate about driving digital transformation for their customers through a deep understanding of their business challenges.
solution_summary: zeb recently launched their SuperInsight self-service reporting engine, built with Databricks tools. Part of their SuperDesk suite of AI-powered service desk products that integrate with existing platforms like ServiceNow and Jira, the idea arose from growing demand from customers who were also using the Databricks Data + AI Platform . These customers sought a way to interact with their data more efficiently and reduce the workload on data analysts who manually handle numerous requests. zeb initially developed a generative AI–based system for a large enterprise logistics company, where data plays a critical role. Prior to the implementation, a team of several data analysts managed a substantial backlog of data requests.
